name: MD-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Elfreth's massive financial advantage ($1.14M raised vs. $12.7K)
Prediction markets price Elfreth near-certain to win
model.rationale: The fundamentals point overwhelmingly to Elfreth: a D+12 district, incumbency, and a fundraising edge of roughly 90-to-1 over Flowers, whose campaign has raised only about $12,700. Markets price her win probability at about 95%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: A surprise national Republican wave environment or an unexpected Elfreth scandal could narrow the margin, though flipping the seat remains highly unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Maryland's 3rd District leans firmly Democratic, and first-term incumbent Sarah Elfreth is running for reelection with every structural advantage. She has raised over $1.1 million and holds more than $330,000 in cash, while Republican Berney Flowers has raised under $13,000 with about $2,000 on hand and no outside support on either side.

No general-election polls or expert ratings exist for the race, but prediction markets give Elfreth roughly a 95% chance of winning. With the district's partisan lean, her incumbency, and her overwhelming financial edge, this race sits solidly in Safe D territory.
